baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ... يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا ... أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The place named by مأوى still gathers and contains, but fire inverts shelter into an active enclosure: exhaustive recurrence joins attempted خروج to compelled عود.

activation_trace.role: Gathering into a shelter supplies the enclosure that fire perversely retains.
Blazing fire with agitated movement makes the abode active rather than static.
Wholeness and enclosure amplify كلما into exhaustive recurrence.
Passage outside supplies the boundary crossing repeatedly attempted.
Return after departure closes each attempted crossing back into the abode.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only the destination where escape attempts fail.
changed_reading.after: Fire is an anti-refuge whose containing function is intensified: every attempted crossing of its boundary regenerates residence inside it.

baseline_models.mechanism: The concrete branch image of fisq is an interior breaking through its rind. The verse gives people defined by illicit emergence a desired خروج, then reverses their characteristic motion by returning them inside.

activation_trace.role: A ripe interior breaking out of its rind gives fisq a concrete boundary-breaking image.
Emergence from a place repeats the transgressors' defining outward motion as an escape attempt.
Return after departure reverses that outward motion rather than merely stopping it.
The gathering place supplies the inside to which boundary breakers are repeatedly regathered.

changed_reading.before: Fisq names guilt, followed by an unrelated failed escape.
changed_reading.after: The punishment formally reverses fisq's own emergence image: those who broke out of a limit are made unable to break out of their final enclosure.

baseline_models.mechanism: The primary ر و د inventory supplies intention and restless back-and-forth, while its non-dominant ر د د mapping supplies repetition and confusion. Joined to habitual return and accumulated fatigue, the desire to leave is already shaped like the loop that defeats it.

activation_trace.role: Will and purposive inclination supply the genuine intention to leave.
Going and coming without settling turns intention into oscillation.
The packet's secondary mapping contributes repeated motion and perplexity as an exploratory prefiguration of return.
Fatigue and loss of sharpness accumulate across the repeated attempts marked by كلما.
Habit and repeated practice turn the imposed return into a settled loop.

changed_reading.before: A fresh act of will is externally frustrated each time.
changed_reading.after: Volition itself oscillates inside a trained cycle: desire, motion, rejection, and return recur as one captivity mechanism.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ ... ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered command converts what had been assigned to falsehood into direct experience. Punitive pain and the repeated fire become evidence, so the sentence is simultaneously penalty and embodied refutation.

activation_trace.role: Speech brought into utterance supplies the explicit verdict and command.
A thing's indication functioning as speech lets the experienced state corroborate the spoken verdict.
Knowing through trial turns denied information into personally undergone evidence.
Severe pain and punishment give that verification its penal force.
Assigning a thing to falsehood identifies the prior epistemic act now being reversed.
Illumination makes the twice-named fire a disclosed reality as well as a source of pain.

changed_reading.before: The condemned are verbally taunted while being punished for denial.
changed_reading.after: The command stages a forced proof: speech, illumination, pain, and tasting make the denied object experientially undeniable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening opposition between delivered truth and the claim of fabrication gives the focus command a forensic history. Those who once supplied accusatory speech now receive authoritative speech and must experience the reality they classified as false.

activation_trace.role: Delivery and conveyance establish the book as something sent to its hearers.
Speech that attributes what was not said supplies the earlier accusatory speech act.
Fabricated falsehood specifies the content of that accusation.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies the counterclaim that punishment later verifies.
The passive utterance reverses speaker and hearer positions at the point of judgment.
Attribution to falsehood links the final experience to the earlier speech dispute.
Trial by direct experience closes the dispute in the body.

structural_cues: 32:2-3 moves from delivered, doubtless truth to an accusation of fabrication; 32:20 reverses who speaks and who must receive the claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed speech acts and a final command; I infer a forensic reversal, while a live simpler alternative is thematic repetition of denial without a speaker-role mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Tasting refutes denial only at the moment of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The focus closes a surah-long speech dispute: the former accusers become addressed defendants, and experience adjudicates their fabrication claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The managed sky-earth-ascent route and its measured, counted time activate the focus loop as a deliberately administered anti-ascent. The secondary ع د د mapping inside أُعيدوا makes each return feel scheduled or countable, not chaotic.

activation_trace.role: Managing an affair by attending to its outcome supplies administration of the larger route.
Ascent supplies the open upward movement that the focus's closed circuit denies.
A measure reaching its fixed limit supplies bounded duration.
Counted time and recurrence provide the temporal template for repeated return.
The focus root's secondary count mapping carries the same timed recurrence into أُعيدوا.
Exhaustive totality makes the recurrence apply whenever an exit is attempted.
Attempted passage outward is the movement repeatedly folded back into the circuit.

structural_cues: 32:5 traces command from sky to earth and back upward in measured time; 32:20 traces desire outward and compulsory motion back inward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two directional cycles and a shared ع د د target; I infer administered periodicity in the punishment, while the live alternative is that 32:5 only supplies cosmological scale, not a schedule for each return.

changed_reading.before: The escape cycle is locally repetitive.
changed_reading.after: The cycle can be carried as a measured anti-ascent: an administered route whose only completed direction is back into confinement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning, extraction, new creation, death, and return establish an open transformation sequence. The criminals then request return for renewed action, but the focus grants only a return into fire; خروج becomes an aborted anti-creation.

activation_trace.role: Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies the creation cycle's opening pole.
An essence gently extracted supplies generative emergence from containing matter.
Creative bringing-into-being specifies the renewed transformation the deniers contest.
Loss of life supplies the threshold after which the broader return occurs.
Return to what preceded supplies the open eschatological direction toward the Lord.
The plea to be returned supplies the desired restorative route toward changed action.
The desired emergence resembles extraction but fails to cross its boundary.
Compelled return redirects the creation-return pattern into fire rather than renewed life.

structural_cues: 32:7-12 sequences beginning, extracted origin, denied new creation, death, return to the Lord, and a plea to return and act; 32:20 answers escape with a different return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the transformation sequence and both return directions; I infer the focus as an anti-creation reversal, while the live alternative is a narrower contrast between an unanswered plea and punishment logistics.

changed_reading.before: The focus reverses transgressive boundary breaking within one enclosure.
changed_reading.after: Its failed emergence also inverts the surah's generative cycle: the only transformation allowed is reconstitution of confinement, not renewed agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing and sight are first given, then claimed after the criminals see and hear with certainty; an earlier command to taste answers forgetting. In the focus, tasting what was denied becomes the last, compulsory epistemic channel and an embodied replacement for failed remembrance.

activation_trace.role: Auditory perception supplies one originally granted route to recognition.
Visual perception supplies the paired route to recognition.
The criminals' belated seeing marks perception arriving after the decisive threshold.
Hearing as understanding and compliance exposes the earlier failure as more than acoustic.
Settled knowledge without doubt names the belated epistemic result.
Loss of remembrance supplies the deficit to which punitive tasting responds.
Repeated experiential tasting establishes punishment as knowledge by ordeal before the focus repeats it.
Direct trial makes the denied fire knowable through the body.
Prior assignment to falsehood identifies why compulsory experience replaces ordinary testimony.

structural_cues: 32:9 grants hearing and sight; 32:12 reports belated seeing, hearing, and certainty; 32:14 joins forgetting to two taste commands; 32:20 joins tasting directly to denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sensory sequence and explicit forgetting/denial links; I infer tasting as forced epistemic closure and embodied memory, while pain without an epistemic function remains a live literal layer.

changed_reading.before: Tasting is a vivid synonym for suffering and proof.
changed_reading.after: Tasting is the compulsory sense left after hearing, sight, and remembrance failed to govern action; punishment makes cognition bodily inescapable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those responsive to reminder freely detach their sides from resting places and receive concealed repose for the eyes, then gardens as prepared hospitality. The focus mirrors every element negatively: the same refuge word contains transgressors in fire, their attempted detachment is reversed, and tasting replaces hospitality.

activation_trace.role: Recovery of what is remembered supplies the stimulus to freely responsive bodily motion.
One thing springing away from close attachment supplies voluntary detachment from rest.
A side adhering to the ground supplies the resting place from which believers detach.
Quiet repose of the eye supplies the concealed rest answering that voluntary detachment.
A garden enclosed by trees supplies the hospitable counterpart to fiery enclosure.
The same gathering refuge image establishes an exact spatial hinge between the paired outcomes.
Provision prepared for a guest makes the garden refuge explicitly hospitable.
The fire retains gathering and residence while reversing the prior refuge's hospitality.
Attempted detachment from fire is the coerced inverse of freely leaving the beds.
Forced return cancels bodily freedom and restores attachment to the anti-refuge.
Tasting supplies the reception act that punishment substitutes for guest provision.

structural_cues: 32:15-17 moves from reminder to voluntary bodily detachment and hidden eye-rest; 32:19-20 pairs two مأوى outcomes, but only the garden is named as prepared hospitality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched body-space and refuge-hospitality terms; I infer a reciprocal architecture, while a live alternative treats night devotion and the two destinations as adjacent but independent contrasts.

changed_reading.before: Fire is an inverted shelter that mechanically prevents exit.
changed_reading.after: It is the counter-refuge to freely chosen detachment and guest reception: coerced attachment and punitive tasting invert repose, hospitality, and bodily freedom together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah distinguishes nearer from greater punishment and gives the nearer tasting a possible return function. Against that opening, the focus's passive return becomes the dark endpoint of failed feedback: voluntary moral رجوع is replaced by involuntary spatial إعادة.

activation_trace.role: Experience by ordeal supplies the nearer punishment as feedback rather than mere information.
Punitive pain spans the explicitly contrasted nearer and greater scales.
Nearness supplies an earlier, more reachable stage of correction.
Greater magnitude supplies the escalated stage represented by the focus fire.
Turning back from a wrong supplies the voluntary corrective return still held open by the nearer warning.
Compelled physical return replaces the unrealized moral turning back.
The same experiential mechanism remains, but now verifies the terminal object of denial.
Punishment supplies the painful continuity between corrective warning and terminal confinement.

structural_cues: 32:21 follows the focus with nearer punishment, greater punishment, and the possibility that they return; 32:20 instead repeatedly returns them into the greater fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two punishments and two differently voiced returns; I infer a failed-feedback escalation from voluntary correction to compulsory reset, while the live alternative simply separates worldly warning from final punishment.

changed_reading.before: Return is the mechanical closure of each attempted escape.
changed_reading.after: Return also marks failed correction: because experiential warning did not produce voluntary رجوع, final experience produces only involuntary إعادة into the denied consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water is driven into barren earth, hidden growth is brought out, and the crop becomes food and a visible sign. Fire runs the material process backward: it contains, cancels خروج, and makes its inhabitants taste punishment. The shared ك ل ل target in context eating and focus كلما adds an exploratory all-consuming edge.

activation_trace.role: Water delivered by irrigation supplies the life-bearing input to the open process.
Earth stripped of vegetation supplies the initially closed, unproductive substrate.
Bringing a hidden thing into appearance supplies successful generative emergence.
Growth and cultivation specify what successful emergence produces.
Eating the produced food supplies nourishing consumption.
The secondary ك ل ل target contributes totality, linking consumption exploratorily to the focus's exhaustive recurrence.
Seeing makes the fertile output an offered sign rather than a hidden process.
Blazing fire replaces life-bearing water as the medium surrounding the inhabitants.
Desired emergence from fire is blocked, reversing the crop's successful appearance.
Exhaustive recurrence turns the failed emergence into an encompassing process.
Literal tasting supplies the anti-nourishing reception imposed in place of eating produce.

structural_cues: 32:27 sequences water to barren earth, successful causative خروج, crop, eating, and sight; 32:20 sequences fire, failed intransitive خروج, return, tasting, and denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed material sequences and a shared خروج root; I infer an ecological counter-process, while the live alternative is that cultivation is an independent sign of resurrection with no direct material analogy to fire.

changed_reading.before: The fire enclosure reverses human boundary crossing.
changed_reading.after: It can also be read as an anti-field: where water makes buried life emerge for nourishment, fire forces emergent bodies back and converts consumption into punitive tasting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question about the opening is answered by a day of decisive judgment with neither benefit nor reprieve, followed by reciprocal waiting and withdrawal. The focus supplies a bodily micro-image of that closure: every apparent aperture of خروج is immediately shut by return.

activation_trace.role: An opened closure and widened entrance supply the spatial possibility asked about.
Judgment that resolves closure fixes the opening as a decisive verdict rather than available escape.
The explicit absence of benefit removes late belief as a usable exit.
Waiting and granting delay supply the reprieve that is explicitly withheld.
Turning one's side away supplies the final withdrawal from further exchange.
Mutual waiting holds both sides at the threshold of the decisive event.
Passage outside supplies the repeatedly appearing aperture.
Immediate return closes that aperture before it becomes egress.

structural_cues: 32:28 asks when the opening comes; 32:29 names it as a day with no benefit and no delay; 32:30 ends in withdrawal and waiting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both spatial and judicial branches of فتح plus denied delay; I infer that the focus escape loop concretizes closure, while the live alternative keeps فتح solely as judgment or victory rather than an aperture image.

changed_reading.before: The enclosure closes only around individual escape attempts.
changed_reading.after: The failed exit becomes a local enactment of final closure: the decisive opening opens judgment while opening no route out and allowing no postponement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates remote dairy and animal-motion branches of ك ذ ب, not the ordinary sense of denial. It remains valid as a structural echo anchored in تكذبون and the verse's explicit run-stop-return sequence; downstream prose should present it as a branch-induced analogy, never as a translation of تكذبون.

activation_trace.role: Back-and-forth unrest supplies the repeated launch of the escape attempt.
Movement outside supplies the run that seems capable of crossing the boundary.
Return after departure supplies the interruption and reversal.
Milk expected to persist but disappearing supplies an image of anticipated duration failing.
An animal running a stretch and then stopping supplies a close motion-image for the aborted escape.

changed_reading.before: Denial is the past proposition for which the escapees are punished.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial's own branch images are reenacted by escape: presumed continuity fails, forward motion stops, and the denied pattern becomes bodily fate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عذاب branches toward sweetness, not eating or drinking, and withholding, while the surface denotes punishment. The collision remains anchored in ذوقوا عذاب and is sharpened by prepared hospitality and eating elsewhere; downstream prose should call it an anti-meal material analogy and keep severe punishment as the controlling surface sense.

activation_trace.role: A gathering shelter supplies the setting in which reception would ordinarily protect a guest.
Tasting food supplies the meal-shaped action imposed by the command.
Sweet, palatable water or food supplies the positive nourishment that punishment grotesquely negates.
A body refusing or unable to eat and drink supplies anti-consumption inside the taste command.
Withholding and weaning supply deprivation as a functional dimension of punishment.
Severe pain and punishment retain the controlling literal outcome.
Provision prepared for a guest supplies the positive hospitality inverted by the focus command.
Eating produced food supplies the nourishing act against which punitive tasting reads as an anti-meal.

changed_reading.before: Taste is simply an idiom for undergoing painful punishment.
changed_reading.after: The fire-refuge stages anti-hospitality: its only provision is a commanded taste that converts sweetness, drinking, and nourishment into pain, abstention, and withholding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the flowering branch of the fire root ن و ر across an ecological scene. It remains anchored in the twice-named النار, the explicit failed خروج, and 32:27's successful خروج of crop; downstream prose should mark it as a cross-domain image of anti-growth, not claim that نار lexically means flower here.

activation_trace.role: A tree putting forth blossom supplies the distant emergence image that fire reverses.
Desired emergence from the fiery medium is the growth-like motion that fails.
Delivered water supplies the fertile medium opposed to fire.
Vegetation-stripped earth supplies the dormant substrate that nevertheless opens to growth.
Bringing the hidden into appearance supplies successful emergence from the earth.
Cultivated growth supplies the realized flowering trajectory denied in fire.

changed_reading.before: Fire is the burning medium from which escape is blocked.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a failed flowering medium: unlike watered barren earth, it permits no life-bearing emergence and folds every attempted sprouting back inside.

strongest_changes: Fisq's image of breaking out of a rind is reversed by the transgressors' inability to break out of fire.
The paired refuge scenes turn fire into anti-hospitality and forced attachment, opposed to voluntary detachment, repose, and prepared garden reception.
Tasting becomes compulsory epistemic closure after hearing, sight, remembrance, and corrective return failed.
The nearer punishment's hoped-for رجوع is darkly replaced by repeated compulsory إعادة into the greater punishment.
The cultivation scene activates fire as an anti-field where generative خروج and nourishing consumption are reversed.
summary.what_was_special: Split mappings made the loop latent inside volition and return themselves, while branch-distant images preserved three odd but anchored readings: denial replaying an aborted run, punishment as an anti-meal, and fire as failed flowering. These coexist with the stronger refuge, sensory, and corrective-return models rather than resolving into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the non-dominant ر د د and ع د د mappings are productive enough for prose or should remain audit-only activations.
Whether the water-earth-crop sequence intentionally countermodels the fire-exit-taste sequence or only offers an analogical resonance.
How far to press مأوى as anti-hospitality without obscuring its straightforward function as a final destination.
Whether tasting should be rendered primarily as epistemic verification, punitive experience, deprivation, or all three as coexisting layers.
